text:
maya: Quick heads-up — late-night incremental restart planned for us-west2 tonight. Window 01:00-03:00 UTC. This is a staged NIC microcode + GPU driver refresh for racks r-12..r-18. Expected impact: rolling node drains with warm backfill, short-lived task evictions, Dedicated pools may see 5-10% capacity dip for a few minutes per cohort.

maya: Plan: 1) Canary on r-12 (01:00 UTC) 2) If canary healthy, stagger cohorts every 10m (1 rack at a time) 3) Prefix cache warmup and KV-cache seed after each cohort 4) Auto-fallback to compatible model variants for latency-sensitive routes

maya: Please ack if any high-priority customers scheduled jobs between 01:00-04:00 UTC. Also flag any pinned model rollouts that must avoid this window.

leo: acked. Can we reduce canary to 30s smoke instead of full 5m perf run? want to avoid long warmup if it fails.

maya: good call. switch canary to 30s perf + basic inference smoke, then 2m stability check. If any anomaly, automatic rollback to pre-update kernel + driver.

sam: pinging product for two customers with nightly batch: @talia are your teams impacted?

talia: our nightly embed jobs start 02:30 UTC but they use Dedicated in eu-west1, should be fine. one partner does cross-region inference to us-west2 at 02:45 — i'll ask them to reschedule to 03:30 Monday if possible.

sam: thanks. also note that we'll hit burst capacity for a few minutes while backfilling hotspots — cost estimate ~+$450 for the window if we use spare burst nodes. worth approving?

talia: given it's a security microcode job, let's accept the cost. please track on the PR for chargeback.

leo: small ops note — ensure KV cache seed command runs after each cohort: ```
kubectl run kv-seeder --image=infra/kv-seeder:prod -- /seed --region us-west2 --cohort r-12
```

leo: also we should pin the graceful-drain timeout to 300s and skip node-proxy-evac to lower jitter.

maya: confirmed: graceful-drain=300s, skip-proxy-evac=true. We'll run a preflight at 00:30 UTC (health checks + canary smoke). If anything flakey, we'll abort and rebook.

oncall-bot: runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/drain-driver-update — preflight checklist required. Alerts will escalate to oncall if >=3 failed pods in a cohort within 5m.

deploy-bot: Canary r-12 smoke completed (01:00:45 UTC). smoke OK. proceeding with r-13 in 10m. logs: https://logs.internal/us-west2/r-12/canary/1718209462

leo: copying notes to maintenance doc and tagging stakeholders.

maya: final ask — folks with long-running evaluations, please pause or pin Eval jobs to non-us-west2 for tonight. I'll open a post-mortem thread if anything unexpected. :thumbsup:

sam: ack.

talia: ack, moving partner scheduled job.

leo: ack and monitoring.
